html:
Join the Goodwill Ambassador Program

Share your healthcare story. Get recognized. Earn rewards.

At Goodwill Staffing, we believe every healthcare journey is worth sharing. Whether you’re on assignment in a new city, traveling between shifts, or capturing small moments of joy on the job — your story has the power to inspire others. That’s why we created the #Goodwiller Ambassador Program: to give our healthcare professionals a platform to express themselves, build community, and earn a little something extra for the stories they already live every day.

📩 Become an Ambassador

How the Ambassador Program Works

1. Sign Up

Get started by contacting our team and completing the quick onboarding process. Only registered ambassadors are eligible for rewards.

2. Post Your Story

Share experiences on your favorite social media platform. It could be a travel moment, a tip from the floor, a work-life balance snapshot — whatever reflects your journey.

3. Tag & Collaborate

Tag @GoodwillStaffing in your post and include #Goodwiller. On Instagram, make Goodwill Staffing a collaborator so we can share it too!

4. Earn Perks & Recognition

Get rewarded with gift cards, swag, scrubs, travel perks — and maybe even win our Ambassador of the Year grand prize trip to Ottawa!

Every shift has a story. Share yours.

Why Join the Ambassador Program?

Here's What You Get!

Whether you post weekly or just once a quarter — your story matters, and your perks are waiting!

A fully hosted trip to Ottawa to celebrate your impact.Email Ust to Get Started

What Should You Post?

Your story matters — and it doesn’t have to be polished. Just authentic.

📩 Become an Ambassador

Not sure if your idea fits? If it’s respectful, real, and meaningful — it’s perfect. Need help? Reach out to digitalmarketing@goodwillstaffing.ca

Ready to Become a Goodwill Ambassador?

Your journey. Your story. Your voice. Share it with the world — and earn recognition for the work you already do.

Want even more tips on balancing travel nursing and lifestyle? Check out this post on living your best travel nurse life in Canada.

FAQ's

Do I have to post every month?

Nope! One post per quarter keeps you active, but you can post as often as you’d like.

What if I don’t get a lot of likes or views?

We value consistency and authenticity — not follower count.

Can I participate even if I’m not currently on assignment?

Yes! Share your past experiences or industry insights — they all count.

I’m not “creative” — is this still for me?

100%. If you can take a photo, write a sentence, or record a 15-sec clip — you’re in.

How do I get started?

Just send an email to digitalmarketing@goodwillstaffing.ca and we’ll guide you from there. Only registered ambassadors are eligible for rewards. Make sure you email us to complete onboarding before you post!

We created this program to celebrate you — the incredible healthcare professionals who inspire us daily. Join the community. Share your voice. Let’s grow together.

Want to level up your social posts? Here’s a great guide on taking eye-catching photos for Instagram — perfect for travel nurses sharing their story.
